cards.title: Prove one shared-iPad classroom loop
cards.summary: Student chooses name, scans one worksheet type, result saves, teacher reviews problem cases.
cards.why_it_matters: This is the core product promise and must work before broad dashboards or marketplace scaling.

cards.title: Lock the first reliable worksheet family
cards.summary: Use disciplined QR/layout/answer-key geometry and a small set of Grade 2 sheets.
cards.why_it_matters: Marketplace assets should compound from repeatable formats, not one-off sheets.

cards.title: Make test evidence visible and plain-English
cards.summary: Track Playwright smoke tests, real worksheet tests, replay/bake-off results, and iPad findings.
cards.why_it_matters: Tony needs to know what is actually proven versus merely working in one local path.

cards.title: Deploy scangrade.io with shared persistence
cards.summary: HTTPS frontend plus minimal roster/submission/review backend for multiple iPads.
cards.why_it_matters: LocalStorage is acceptable for prototype validation but not a real shared classroom.

cards.title: Package a small solid TPT product set
cards.summary: Start with a few polished, tested, repeatable worksheet products and clear listing copy. Draft plan exists in products/TPT_FIRST_OPEN_DIVIDER_PRODUCT_PLAN.md.
cards.why_it_matters: Commercial value comes from trustworthy classroom assets, not broad unfinished variety.

cards.title: Create teacher-facing marketing and promotion
cards.summary: Position ScanGrade around saved marking time, shared iPads, and low-friction assessment.
cards.why_it_matters: Marketing should reflect the actual product proof and teacher pain point.

cards.title: Use Mission Control as durable shared memory
cards.summary: Keep current mission, decisions, risks, tests, docs, worksheets, and Codex autonomy rules visible.
cards.why_it_matters: The project should not depend on hidden chat history or Tony remembering every technical thread.
